commentary.text: 90+8' Bastian Dankert is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) receives a yellow card!
90+6' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) has been ejected from today's game! He receives a red card after being shown two yellow cards and has to leave the pitch.
90+4' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:2.
90+1' 1 - 1 Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Mio Backhaus. 1:1.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies onto the left post!
86' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
85' Werder Bremen enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
82' The substitution has been made. Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) has replaced Eric Martel.
81' Horst Steffen has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) replacing Cameron Puertas.
78' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) receives a yellow card.
78' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Werder Bremen.
77' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
75' The referee shows the yellow card to Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln).
75' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) is punished with the yellow card.
75' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen). Bastian Dankert saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
74' The referee allows time for a substitution. Cenk Ozkacar will be replaced by Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln).

73' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
70' Keke Topp is being substituted because of an injury. Horst Steffen sends Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen) on the pitch.
69' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
68' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
66' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
66' The current number of shots on goal is 3:1.

63' Said El Mala plays a short pass through to Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) inside the box, but he scuffs his effort well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
62' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) extricates himself from the difficult situation with a good pass, comfortably eluding the pressing opponent.
60' A brilliant cross into the box finds Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln), who directs his header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
57' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Werder Bremen players look gutted.
55' Goal! Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0.

52' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) connects with a cross on the edge of the box, controls the ball and pulls the trigger. Mio Backhaus makes a beautiful save to deny his effort which would have ended in the bottom left corner.
52' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Bastian Dankert signals. FC Koln are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

50' The ball rebounds out to Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.

49' A pass travels right across the box to Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Marvin Schwabe denies him with a decent save.
47' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
46' Lukas Kwasniok makes a switch. Kristoffer Lund is coming on in place of Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) at the start of the second period.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Lukas Kwasniok gives a chance to Tom Krauss and Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) is off.
46' Half-time substitution. Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) will not participate anymore and Niklas Stark is coming on.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
45+2' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) brings his opponent down. Bastian Dankert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.

45+2' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the right post. Marvin Schwabe guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

44' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
44' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) takes a short corner kick.

43' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball goes behind for a corner. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
42' The FC Koln players are exchanging some short passes.
38' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
38' Bastian Dankert interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln). Werder Bremen get a free kick.
38' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) sends a long ball in, but Mio Backhaus comfortably gathers the ball.
37' A clumsy foul by Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle. It's a free kick to FC Koln, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
35' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
33' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
31' Bastian Dankert blows the whistle, Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) is penalised for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to FC Koln.
29' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends a long ball in, but Marvin Schwabe comfortably gathers the ball.
26' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

25' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee points to the corner flag and Werder Bremen will take a corner.
22' 1 - 0 Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) leaps to meet an excellent cross and steers a fantastic header past the goalkeeper, inside the right post.
22' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
21' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just over the crossbar.
20' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

20' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked. Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
18' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Werder Bremen.

16' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
13' A crossfield pass from Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) fails to find any of his teammates.
12' Problems for Lukas Kwasniok as Dominique Heintz (1. FC Koln) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Rav van den Berg replaces him.
10' Dominique Heintz (1. FC Koln) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
9' The game is interrupted now, Dominique Heintz (1. FC Koln) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
8' It could have been a good chance to score! Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) fails to release Jens Stage with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
4' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

3' What a miss! Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
2' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
1' The first half has started.
Werder Bremen will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Bastian Dankert.
